specs.title: FR13-TC-11 [edge] a client-supplied total_amount is recomputed by the backend, not stored as sent

annotations.description: Closes OQ-06, flagged in HW02 as a concern but never tested. README FR-08 requires the backend to recompute the total from the cart; api_specification.md 4.3 lets the client supply it. The cart is filled through POST /api/cart with known prices, so the correct total is EXACTLY 150000*2 + 99000 = 399000, and the row submits 999999999 instead. Asserting the stored value equals 399000 - rather than merely differing from what was sent - is what makes this falsifiable: a build that stored any other wrong number, or clamped, would pass a not-equal check.
